title: Municipal Avenue affordable housing: 18-unit and 8-unit apartment buildings
code_edition: Buildings Accessibility Regulations; edition not stated

facts.text: The affordable-housing project had two two-storey buildings, one with 18 units and one with 8 units.
The appeal concerned the regulator’s interpretation of section 4(3) for a building with more than 4 and fewer than 15 residential units and the requirement for a level/ramp-connected unit.
The appellant referred to the smaller building design and sought an appeal of the director’s interpretation.

limitations: Comparative source from outside Alberta; it cannot establish Alberta code performance or approval.
